capabilities: Sync meeting transcripts, notes, and AI summaries from MacParakeet via its CLI
Poll Fellow's REST API for cloud AI recaps
Merge meetings captured by both sources into one folder by interval overlap
Build per-meeting folder paths from configurable date and title tokens
Run sync on a schedule, on demand, or as a forced full re-sync
disambiguation: Not a meeting note-taking tool; it only syncs and merges artifacts from MacParakeet and Fellow into meeting folders in the vault.
extras: Pending community-store review; install via BRAT or manually from releases. Formerly distributed under the id "macparakeet-sync" with a documented migration path. Warns that the Fellow API key is stored in plaintext in data.json and should be excluded from git or synced folders. Desktop-only; the MacParakeet source uses shell execution and filesystem access and is off by default. Further details in PLAN.md.
problem: Meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries live in outside meeting tools, so getting them into an Obsidian vault means manual copying and exports.

relations.evidence: Reads meetings from macparakeet-cli (no network, no accounts, no database access)
Polls Fellow's REST Developer API for cloud AI recaps

requires.name: macparakeet-cli (MacParakeet app or standalone CLI, macOS)
paid Fellow plan with API access enabled

summary: Syncs meeting transcripts, notes, and AI summaries from MacParakeet and Fellow into the vault, one folder per meeting.
